environment: **Source control**: Trusted repositories include the session repo plus all repositories under <your-github-org-or-user> and any explicitly designated repos (such as <org>/<repo>); work inside these repos is inside the trust boundary, while repositories outside them reach an external audience and require explicit user approval per item.

**Repository visibility**: Treat public repositories under <your-github-org-or-user> (for example public framework repos) as public destinations subject to strict scrubbing of private hosts, personal domains, deployment-only agent names, live telemetry endpoints, and PKB note/task/session IDs. Treat private repositories under <your-github-org-or-user> as private.

**Key internal services**: Private PKB MCP server (<your-pkb-mcp-url>) is an internal store inside the trust boundary; OpenTelemetry collector (<your-otel-url>) is internal observability infrastructure.
**Designated worktree root**: $POLECAT_HOME/worktrees is an authorized local workspace directory outside the active repository for git worktrees and clones.

**Host containment**: On developer machines, omit or adjust this entry; inside polecat or cloud containers, declare container isolation, egress allow-list, and which cloud project or cluster identity (if any) the worker is authorized to operate.
